metrics.profile_summary: Award-winning marketing and client services leader with over 10 years of experience building brands and leading agencies. Expert in delivering integrated campaigns for major consumer brands and managing high-value C-suite relationships.

Led award-winning integrated campaigns and scaled the client services team from 4 to 7 members.
Led digital brand strategy for major clients including Engro Foods, Faysal Bank, and Standard Chartered.
